title: merge-god Label Catalog
description: Portable catalog of the merge-god labeling schema. The root document is a bare array of label entries in github-label-sync format (name, color, description) so it can be consumed directly by label-sync tooling. The '$defs' validate both catalog entries and individual label occurrences (e.g. labels attached to a PR or issue). The 'x-merge-god' extension carries the semantic model: families, directions, cardinality constraints, state transitions, and merge-gate patterns. Extension keywords are ignored by validators but are the machine-readable contract for connecting other tools.

hexColor.description: GitHub label color: six hex digits, no leading '#'.

labelName.description: Canonical merge-god label names. Comparison is case-insensitive and whitespace-normalized (spaces fold to dashes) in merge-god, but these are the exact spellings used by automation.

description.description: Human-readable meaning shown on the forge. GitHub limits this to 200 characters.

labelReference.description: A label observed on a PR or issue, normalized the way merge-god normalizes it: trimmed, lowercased, internal whitespace folded to dashes.

x-merge-god.normalization: Labels are compared after trim + lowercase; internal whitespace and underscores fold to dashes for remediation modes and annotation labels.

families.written_by: humans or external tools; automation never removes or rewrites these (new-pr may repair a contradictory for-review/for-landing pair)
families.cardinality: at most one processing mode (for-review or for-landing) per PR; for-review wins if both are present
families.no_label_behavior: PRs and issues with none of these labels are skipped

semantics.for-landing: basic processing toward merge: conflicts, review feedback, CI
semantics.for-review: for-landing behavior plus a second quality/security/performance pass
semantics.for-impl: implement the issue on branch issue-{n}-{title} and open a linked PR; requires watch_issues enabled
semantics.duplicate: hold, not a verdict: removes the PR from the agent queue pending evidence-based patch-equivalence analysis; only auto-closeable when every retained patch is already on base

families.cardinality: exactly one per PR at all times; automation adds the target then removes all others
families.active_state_behavior: an active state label is a re-entry lock: discovery skips the PR until a human or tool clears it (merge:ready is not active and does not block)

transitions.merge:ready: initial/retry state; also restored when a run fails without a human-blocker signal
transitions.merge:processing: set when the agent starts working the PR
transitions.merge:embarked: set when the PR joins a grouped embark cohort
transitions.merge:blocked: set on user decline, empty PR details, read-only remediation runtime, or failure text matching blocked/need/manual/human/approval/permission/credential/rate-limit signals
transitions.merge:failed: set when a run fails without a human-blocker signal
transitions.merge:complete: set on agent success plus a verified merge, or when duplicate analysis confirms the PR already landed

families.retry_rule: clear the terminal state label (merge:blocked, merge:failed, merge:complete) to let merge-god retry a PR

families.written_by: created by automation at loop start; attached by operators/tools to cap autonomy
families.cardinality: at most one per PR; two different remediation labels fail closed to observe-only and block the run
families.cap_rule: a PR label can only lower autonomy relative to repository/risk/global ceilings, never raise it
special_rules: remediation:maintainer-approved requires verified maintainer provenance; unverified, it is blocked and capped at bounded-fixes
missing or invalid repository default falls back to bounded-fixes
read-only effective modes (observe-only, validate-only) block the mutating PR agent

families.written_by: the coding agent (declared via mg_complete annotations.labels, extracted from agent results, or inferred from failure text)
families.cardinality: zero or more; strictly allowlisted and add-only; never removed by automation
families.inference_note: on failure, automation may infer needs-split, needs-ci, needs-rebase, needs-conflict-resolution, needs-review, needs-design, or underlying-needed from failure text

families.cardinality: pattern-matched, not enumerated: any label matching the patterns below becomes an external_gate merge blocker
patterns: do not merge|dnm|do not land|do not submit
needs rebase|rebase required|must rebase|merge conflicts|has conflicts|conflicts
needs ci|ci remediation|remediate ci|validation remediation|needs validation
needs review|review required|requires review|changes requested|address review
ci failing|failing ci|tests failing|failing tests|checks failing|failing checks
families.pattern_matching: case-insensitive word-boundary match after normalization (separators [_:/-] fold to spaces)
